newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers no peak, firm or non-firm power for Fri.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers no peak, firm or non-firm power for Fri.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) did not offer any firm or non-firm power for delivery during peak demand hours on Friday, the agency said Thursday.
BPA did offer non-firm power during off-peak hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT at $8.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for all deliveries.

Non-firm power at hours ending 0600 and 2300 on Friday was offered at $10.00, while prices for hours ending 0700-0800 were $13.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and $14.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deals.
For today, BPA had offered 200 MW of peak firm power at $18.50 for Northwest deliveries and $20.50 for COB.
